answer_1.quote: We choose 8 seen datasets from the demonstration pool and 15 unseen datasets across 8 task types to test MDR. All datasets are transformed into natural language instructions using randomly selected instruction templates from FLAN  or UDR .
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include generated answers in question answering, translated text in machine translation, summaries in text summarization, and synthesized code in code generation.

answer_2.quote: We report F1 score of Rouge-1 (r-1), Rouge-2 (r-2) and Rouge-L (r-l) on SamSum dataset.
